summary: BMW Auto Leasing LLC filed a routine Form 8-K reporting an Item 8.01 other event: retention of Morgan, Lewis & Bockius LLP and Richards, Layton & Finger, P.A. as counsel for its Form SF-3 shelf registration statement (File No. 333-283340). The registrant attached legality, enforceability, and tax opinions plus accountant consents as Exhibits 5.1, 5.2, 8.1, 23.1, and 23.2. No securities were offered, sold, or priced, and no transactional or corporate event occurred. This is ordinary shelf-maintenance paperwork for BMW Vehicle Lease Trust 2026-2 and related registrants, with no deal terms or risk-arb angle.
